_readme: THE CLIP VARIABLE SHEET: every input a clip chain takes. A recipe is this sheet filled in, under the same rules as the picture sheet (picture-sheet.json `rules`, PSH-1 to PSH-8) plus the clip rules below. The creative dials that apply to video and the 9 guards are added from components/creative-controls/controls.json when the sheet loads. Kinds as in picture-sheet.json.

rules.rule: The spoken line reaches the model only as the voice read (Audio 1); its words are never typed into the prompt.
The clip prompt keeps the maker's four blocks (the files, the look, second by second, always) from video-production/machine/seedance_prompt.py; scene fields reach the clip through those blocks.

A dial, feeling or technique a person changes on the Bench adds its level words as one 'Tone' sentence to the look block; levels set by the brief reach the clip through the brief's scene fields and are recorded on the sheet.
A start and an end picture come from one picture sheet (PSH-7 (one sheet per scene)); a mismatch is flagged and the best attempt used (PSH-8 (outputs never stop)).
The clip is made only on a person's press or a strategy's recorded cost approval; the preview quotes the cost for free.

A shot with an emotion carries a face and gestures (visible actions, not emotion words); a shot with an emotion and no face or gestures is MISSING, not applicable only when the brief writes no emotion.
A person's life marks and own gestures are filled from the character file, or not applicable with 'no character file', so a missing file shows instead of sending nothing.

variables.name: Brand
variables.means: Whose ad this is.

variables.name: The video
variables.means: The video run this clip belongs to.

variables.name: Which clip
variables.means: The clip of the video being made.

variables.name: The scene
variables.means: The scene of the brief this clip shows.

variables.name: The start picture
variables.means: The first frame. The clip starts exactly on it.

variables.name: The end picture
variables.means: The last frame, for a silent clip that ends somewhere new.
na: a talking clip takes no end picture
the clip ends where it starts

variables.name: The voice read
variables.means: The locked read of the line, sent as audio.
na: a silent clip

variables.name: Motion from the ad
variables.means: Blurred pieces of the swipe's shot, for how the camera and hands move.
na: this section does not copy the swipe's movement

variables.name: Start and end pictures match
variables.means: Both pictures come from one picture sheet.
na: a talking clip takes no end picture
the clip ends where it starts
the video run chose both pictures

variables.name: What happens
variables.means: The visible actions, one per few seconds.

variables.name: The feeling in the brief
variables.means: The emotion the brief writes for this shot. It is never sent as a word; it reaches the clip as the face and hands.
na: the brief writes no emotion for this shot

variables.name: The face
variables.means: What the face does.
na: no face in this clip
the brief writes no emotion for this shot

variables.name: The hands
variables.means: What the hands do.
na: no hands in this clip
the brief writes no emotion for this shot

variables.name: Face and hands check
variables.means: The clip builder's own check that every shot's face and gestures are set (filled, or not applicable with its reason).
na: no people in this clip

variables.name: The camera
variables.means: One move from the list.

variables.name: The look
variables.means: The one look for the whole video.

variables.name: How it ends
variables.means: What the take ends on.
na: the next clip carries straight on
the brief sets no end for this take

variables.name: How it hands on
variables.means: How this take joins the next: a cut, continuous, on the action, matched or a whip.
na: the last clip of the video

variables.name: Who is in it
variables.means: The cast member on screen.
na: no people in this clip

variables.name: Their marks
variables.means: Scars, stains, jewellery kept exactly as in the picture.
na: no people in this clip
no character file
spice level 1 leaves marks out

variables.name: Their own gestures
variables.means: Two of the person's habits, used when the shot names no gestures.
na: no people in this clip
no character file
the shot names its own gestures
spice level 1 or 2 leaves them out

variables.name: Length
variables.means: Seconds: the read plus a little, 4 to 30.

variables.name: Quality
variables.means: Made small, sharpened on this Mac.

variables.name: The shape
variables.means: Tall 9:16.

variables.name: How lived-in
variables.means: 1 clean · 2 lived-in · 3 fully lived.

variables.name: Real-life details
variables.means: The small true details sent with the clip.
na: the format has no realism rows

variables.name: No subtitles
variables.means: No words burnt into the clip.

variables.name: No background music
variables.means: Music is added at the edit.

variables.name: The line is never typed
variables.means: CSH-1 (voice is audio).
na: a silent clip

variables.name: The preset
variables.means: The set of dial levels the video aims for.
na: the video brief names no preset

variables.name: The feeling, from the bank
variables.means: The bank emotion the brief's feeling matches.
na: the brief's feeling has no match in the emotion bank
the brief writes no emotion for this shot

variables.name: How that feeling looks on camera
variables.means: The emotion bank's video line, for the face and hands.
na: the brief's feeling has no match in the emotion bank
the brief writes no emotion for this shot

variables.name: The techniques
variables.means: The moves the clip uses.
na: the scene copies the swipe's own moves

variables.name: If it fails
variables.means: What takes over, in order.

variables.name: The run name
variables.means: Where the clip is filed.

variables.name: Cost approved by
variables.means: Who said yes to spending on this clip.

dial_na: the video brief sets no level for this dial
